entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: The people look like ants from[n]all the way up here. I kinda[n]feel like a kaiju.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Oh, but... kaiju are sad creatures...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It's so strange... I'm not afraid[n]of going outside anymore.[n]It just makes me excited.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: I've had so much fun going places[n]with you, [fName]. I could go[n]anywhere in the world with you.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hey, um... am I doing a good[n]job as your girlfriend?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Yay! Phew, I was worried because[n]I didn't have any idea what a[n]girlfriend is supposed to do!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hrmmm, I did a bunch of research,[n]but it's still not enough! How[n]about... a "lover's quarrel"?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Like if I fit the ecology.[n]Or if I move properly like one.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Is that why you stare at me like[n]that? Because I'm your girlfriend?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: It makes my heart beat super fast.[n]It's so cool having a boyfriend...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: And having my boyfriend stare at[n]me makes me super happy... Is that[n]because I'm his girlfriend?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: My face feels like it's on[n]fire... I wonder why...
